item.title: Morning brief, Thursday November 19
item.description: Good morning, Sydney. Happy Thursday. It's Vegas day. Your one big thing is getting to Las Vegas smoothly and arriving ready for Beyond the Apex tonight. Check the United app for your flight time and check in before you start anything else. Then finish packing, including your outfit for tonight and something warm, because Vegas is cool and rainy this evening. Two quick must-dos before you leave: reply to Tina on Vrbo, who is asking about a viewing Friday late afternoon or Saturday while you're away, and decide what to do about the hot tub visit set for tomorrow at seven in the morning, since you won't be home. On the schedule: your flight to Las Vegas today, and Beyond the Apex at the Stirling Club tonight, where your pass is for the evening afterparty, with doors reopening at eight. Weather: Venice is around sixty five with a chance of a light shower. Las Vegas tops out near fifty eight, with light rain likely this evening and lows in the upper forties. Good news on the painting: the shipper confirmed it's collected and they're crafting the packaging. Have a great trip.
